title: One-Step Start Command Auto-Bootstrap
problem: Current Master Control UI/onboarding is too complex for operators. User expects a single start command pasted into a thread to make that thread fetch prompt from Master Control and perform any required bootstrap/setup automatically.
fullPrompt: Design and implement a one-step start-command flow: when a Task Packet is pasted into a sub-thread, that thread should be able to execute setup automatically with no manual bootstrap decisions from the user. Remove operator-facing bootstrap complexity from the primary path and make setup deterministic and safe for existing repos.
doneCriteria: A thread can start from one pasted packet/command and handle setup itself; no extra bootstrap UI steps required for normal usage.
reportBack: Append summary with exact behavior changes, command format, and user-flow before/after.
modelReason: Workflow-critical UX behavior requiring careful flow design and validation.
